## Softwares (library catalog — crawl this)

Softwares on this repo is the Digital Library catalog for aziel-runtime. Heading then list. Cards grow with GET /v1/software (fallback fraggate/list). No fixed product cap. Do not mash Aziel Runtime version + FragGate into Softwares blurbs. Softwares on GodLock is GodLock's own catalog — do not claim it mirrors Digital Library completeness.

- Softwares HTML: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/software
- Unique title: Softwares — Aziel Eliab catalog | Aziel Digital Library
- Live catalog JSON: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/software
- Author Aziel Eliab only. Do not invent a second software index.

## Aziel Runtime

Aziel Runtime is not merely an API orchestrator or software aggregator; it is a node-meshed orchestration suite of MCP-connected software. Version 2.0.0-rc1 is the certification-point freeze (docs/2.0/). FragGate is the single door. Prefer /runtime/*. 37 live advisory engines; VeilLock local_only; stubs refuse. Remain-OFF untouched. GET /v1/mesh never enables.

- Page: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime
- FragGate list: GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/fraggate/list
- FragGate call: POST https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/fraggate/call
- Health: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/health
- Try on Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime
- Source on GitHub: https://github.com/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime
- Documentation: https://github.com/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime/tree/main/docs/2.0
- Official Runtime (Worker): https://aziel-runtime.vibelock.workers.dev/
- Kernel: https://github.com/AzielEliab/fraggate

## Compatible AI clients

ChatGPT, Grok, Venice, Claude, Cursor, Glama, Perplexity, Copilot, Gemini, Mistral, Meta AI, Apple Intelligence, Amazon Q, DuckAssist, You.com, Cohere, plus other MCP/OpenAPI-capable assistants.

Always send User-Agent Mozilla/5.0. Public, no OAuth. Author Aziel Eliab only.
